sourceRefs.locator: City-centre excavations, figs. 3–7. Wooden anvil bases with bronze dust, scrap bronze, the silver coin of 1237/38 from Karakorum’s mint, gravel, paving and trade activities.

Introduction, Historical background and city access discussion at fig. 7. Location on the Orkhon, residence under Ögödei, Rubruck’s visit in 1254, east-gate roads and dense settlement outside the walls. Published online 2021.
Section on artisans, especially the final paragraph on recruitment for construction under Ögödei at Karakorum and under Khubilai at Shangdu and Daidu.

Paragraph beginning “A certain woman from Metz” (Paquette, her family and the Parisian goldsmith); “The Khan’s palace at Karakorum” (the silver tree, bellows, trumpet and servers); “Description of Karakorum” (grain and livestock at the gates). Translation published in 1900.
